additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: ID0460099-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P3 170000415] OCPP Smart Charging error CRM:03056000411
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Schneider,
Many thanks for the prompt reply!
I analyzed thoroughly the logs based on your indications and screenshot, and these are my findings:
First of all, just as a note, I believe the timestamp reported in your screenshot is German time (CET), while our SichargeD logs are UTC. Please correct me if I am wrong.
I can confirm to you that the charger is receiving and accepting the OCPP "SetChargingProfile" commands. Taking as an example yesterday (11.11.2025), here are some examples of OCPP communication and reaction of the charger in terms of power allocation:
From your screenshot, I deduct that your concern is regarding the allocation void between 11:00 and 13:00 (10:00 and 12:00 UTC time)
From a charger point of view, I do not see any anomaly:
A charging session on DC2 is stopped at 2025-11-11T09:56:15, with last [SmartCharging] Power setpoint received: {"msgId":"1ac48bba-55ac-4024-8e22-1bea202375a7","connector":"100:610","maxValue":"30325"}
After the session, Power setpoint is set to 140kW: 2025-11-11T09:56:16.783502+00:00 [FW070005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4129] [SCG]  [SmartCharging] Power setpoint received: {"msgId":"bf5779bf-8a70-475b-9df4-2334d72be6c5","connector":"100:610","maxValue":"140000"}
I understand your Backend set this value of 140kW as failover mechanism. However, between 2025-11-11T09:56:16 (11:00 CET) and 2025-11-11T11:51:16 (12:00 CET), I do not see any issue with the SECC being offline, or with the OCPP connection being offline. Heartbeats were regularly through all this period.
At 2025-11-11T11:51:16 a new session is initiated on DC2, and OCPP "SetChargingProfile" commands are processed correctly.
The only time the charger was offline yesterday was between 2025-11-11T12:43:00 and 2025-11-11T13:04:00, when the FW update to v8.0.5 was executed.
I verified the logs in regards OCPP connection outage since Friday 07.11.2025, and the
OCPP connection was lost (offline) only on Friday between
2025-11-07T08:38:19
and
2025-11-07T08:38:49
(30 seconds). For the rest, I could not see any other events which could have triggered the failover mechanism.
I hope my answer addressed all your doubts and concerns. Please let me know if you require further support or analysis for the Smart Charging problem you faced.
Looking forward to hearing feedback form you soon!
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: AW: AW: AW: ID0460099-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P3 170000415] OCPP Smart Charging error CRM:03056000411
additional_info.body:
Good Morning Fosco,
sorry for my delayed answer, but it took some time to analyze the issue on our CPMS side.
It seems, that there was an OCPP StopTransaction message missing for OCPP transaction ID 63379160.
That is why our CPMS is still sending charging profiles to the charger for the given transaction (see attachment from today; response: error, session not running anymore).
Therefore, our CPMS has not yet created a charge detail record for this session, and the session has not been billed correctly to our customer.
Same situation for OCPP transaction 63122934. No StopTransaction message has been received by our CPMS. Therefore, the session has not been billed correctly.
Maybe that’s why our CPMS ran into failover and allocated power continuously.
Could you please check if the StopTransaction messages have been sent by the charger or not?
It is crucial for us, that OCPP processes are running reliably on the charger in order to have sessions billed correctly.
Thanks and kind regards,
Marius

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: AW: ID0460099-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P3 170000415] OCPP Smart Charging error CRM:03056000411
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Schneider,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0460099.
Apologies for the late reply.
I analyzed the logs in regards of the transaction ID:63379160, and these are my findings:
On 2025-11-19T12:10:29, I see the following authorization via RFID:
OCPP: Send command: Authorize (3db26b12-19c2-46fc-8a90-fcf7bc2f1760) - {"idTag":"047B444AA47880"
DC1 is connected, At 2025-11-19T12:10:45 we send the StartTransaction, but we never received the confirmation:
OCPP: Send command: StartTransaction (6baa2ee8-6e43-4626-814e-5a229942eb89) - {"connectorId":1,"idTag":"047B444AA47880","meterStart":64227070,"timestamp":"2025-11-19T12:10:45.458Z"}
From now on, I see the Set charging profile messages related to the transaction ID:63379160, to which we reply with the following:
OCPP: Send error: SetChargingProfile (638991510621494247-36021) - {"code":"PropertyConstraintViolation","message":"transaction (id: 63379160) currently not running on connector (id: 1)"}
From charger side, the session failed at 2025-11-19T12:12:24.
I believe the problem is that we never received such transactionid, as we did not receive the StartTransaction result.
Please let me know if further analysis is required, or I can close the ticket.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
